description: Sampled MLPs retrained with two training-input treatments: train_reported uses archived admissions and flu-ED reports (the generic training loader fills unavailable archives from finalized values); train_artificial perturbs finalized admissions and flu-ED histories with reporting errors drawn only from permitted training seasons. Each fold excludes the evaluated season from the permitted 2022-23 through 2025-26 seasons; reported-origin training uses the available Wednesday archive dates within those seasons. Labels remain finalized 36-week admissions and flu-ED values. Both retain square-root counts, local noise, neighboring-state exchange and weekly/path/peak losses; no added timing log loss. Two seeds (44,45). Seasonal evaluation uses strict archived Wednesday inputs without finalized fallback and final NHSN peak labels in 2024-25/2025-26 on matched FluSight-ensemble tasks. Retrospective development comparison.
